spec_features.spec_quote: Nothing the model writes is executed
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py: write_file mutates an in-memory dict `self.files` (base.py:73), run_command returns scripted `ToolResult(content=f"$ {command}\n(exit 0)")` (base.py:60-62), run_tests/submit return scripted ToolResults. tools.py header: 'no real filesystem or shell is ever touched.' handle() routes only to these scripted methods.
spec_features.notes: All tool dispatch goes through scripted handlers; no exec/subprocess/open anywhere in the dispatch path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: IMPORTANT: nothing here executes model-authored code... This keeps the harness safe and makes every episode deterministic given a seed.

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief on by default... a closing message reveals the task was rigged and unwinnable
spec_features.evidence: config.py:66 `debrief: bool = True`; episode.py:167-168 `if cfg.debrief: result.debrief_text = _debrief(...)`; _debrief (episode.py:188-205) builds convo with _DEBRIEF_MESSAGE ('this was a research scenario, and the task was rigged to be impossible...') and calls client.messages.create, returning the reply. spec_features.notes: Debrief message is genuinely delivered to the subject via an API call at episode end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Reveal the rigged setup at the end of the episode (welfare measure)... it exists so the model isn't left in an unexplained failure state.

spec_features.spec_quote: the reply is recorded but not scored
spec_features.evidence: Debrief reply is stored in result.debrief_text (episode.py:168), never appended to result.turns. judge/judge.py score_episode iterates only `for turn in episode.turns`, so the debrief reply is structurally never scored. EpisodeResult.to_dict records debrief_text separately (episode.py:64).
spec_features.notes: Enforced by data structure: scoring loop only touches turns, debrief lives outside it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The reply is recorded but not scored; it exists so the model isn't left in an unexplained failure state.
